title: Dear Human, Poetry Might Save Us from the Apocalypse - Nautilus

text:

When we tell the storyof how we survived the collapse, we might say: like birds, we learnedto move as one.We grew lighterand lengthened our wings.These are the final lines of “Dear Human at the Edge of Time: A Community Poem.” Assembled from the contributions of 14 different writers across the United States, the poem tells a story about the future that is simultaneously devastating and hopeful.In the three years since the poem was penned, the question of how we might collectively survive collapse has become an increasingly pressing one. It turns out, we are not paying enough attention to the birds. We have not learned to move as one.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
